title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
rationale: Remote root login increases the impact of credential guessing.

title: Ensure SSH idle timeout is configured
rationale: Idle sessions left open can be reused by another person.

title: Ensure SSH protocol uses strong ciphers only
rationale: Weak ciphers allow traffic to be decrypted if captured.

title: Ensure password minimum length is at least 14
rationale: Short passwords are easier to guess.

title: Ensure account lockout after failed logins
Ensure unused filesystems are disabled
rationale: Unneeded modules enlarge the attack surface.

title: Ensure /tmp is a separate partition
rationale: A separate /tmp can restrict execution and space exhaustion.

title: Ensure time synchronization is in use
Ensure the firewall service is active
Ensure auditd is installed
rationale: Without audit records some investigations lack evidence.

title: Ensure legacy NIS client is not installed
Ensure wireless interfaces are disabled
rationale: Servers without radios cannot use this exposure.

title: Ensure Bluetooth service is disabled
rationale: Servers without radios cannot use this exposure.

title: Ensure core dumps are restricted
rationale: Core dumps may contain sensitive memory contents.

title: Ensure sticky bit is set on world-writable directories
rationale: Prevents users from deleting others' files.

title: Ensure GRUB bootloader password is set
rationale: Check depends on physical-access scope not defined for this VM.
observed: Virtual machine; console access governed by hypervisor
